body.text: The CRD has 13 identical control rod drives: 9 for the primary control rod assemblies and 4 for the secondary.
body.anchor: consists of 13 identical control rod drives

body.text: The CRD supports normal reactivity control and reactor scram. Portions of it provide a primary coolant boundary function.
body.anchor: The CRD supports normal reactivity control and reactor scram functions
The control rod drive assembly includes the control rod drive mechanism

body.text: All of the CRD except the motor controller is in the HAA of the RXB substructure. The motor controller is in the NCB substructure.
body.anchor: The motor controller is located in the Nuclear Island Control Building (NCB) substructure

body.text: The CRDM housings are welded to and supported by penetrations in the RPA.
body.anchor: The CRDM housings are welded to, and structurally supported by, penetrations in the Rotatable Plug Assembly

body.text: The driveline is directly coupled to the CRA through a pneumatically controlled latching mechanism in normal operation.
body.anchor: The driveline is directly coupled to the CRA through a pneumatically-controlled latching mechanism

body.text: The latch engages when the scram valve and cylinder assembly is pressurized with inert gas from the SCG. It releases when gas pressure vents.
body.anchor: The latching mechanism is engaged by pressurizing the scram valve and cylinder assembly

body.text: The assembly has three electric solenoid-operated pilot valves that supply gas to a piston and cylinder.
body.anchor: consists of three electric solenoid-operated pilot valves

body.text: The scram valves are fail-safe, de-energize to vent, and are controlled by the RPS.
body.anchor: The scram valves are fail-safe, de-energize to vent

checks.q: What holds the CRA latched to the driveline?
o: Gas pressure in the scram cylinder
checks.x: Pressurizing the assembly engages the latch, and venting releases it.
checks.anchor: The latching mechanism is engaged by pressurizing the scram valve and cylinder assembly

checks.q: What supplies gas to the scram cylinders?
checks.x: Inert gas is supplied by the SCG.
checks.anchor: with inert gas supplied by the Sodium Cover Gas System

body.text: The CRD positions CRAs for start-up, power control, power shaping, and shutdown from RMC demand signals. The RMC is a subsystem of the NIC.
body.anchor: based on demand signals from the Rod Monitoring and Control System

body.text: Independent drives allow individual CRA positioning, and a fault in one drive does not affect the others.
body.anchor: a fault within a single control rod drive does not affect operation of other control rod drives

body.text: A ball screw drive assembly converts motor rotation to driveline linear motion.
body.anchor: through a ball screw drive assembly within the CRDM housing

body.text: An electro-mechanical brake prevents driveline motion unless a demand signal is present.
body.anchor: An electro-mechanical brake prevents driveline motion unless a demand signal is present

body.text: High speed motor-driven insertion provides power run-back capability.
body.anchor: CRDM high speed motor-driven CRA insertion provides power run-back capability

body.text: The motor controller and drive are powered from the Nuclear Island Uninterruptible AC Power Supply System.
body.anchor: supplied power from the Nuclear Island Uninterruptible AC Power Supply System

checks.q: What prevents driveline motion with no demand signal?
checks.x: An electro-mechanical brake prevents driveline motion unless a demand signal is present.
checks.anchor: An electro-mechanical brake prevents driveline motion unless a demand signal is present

checks.x: High speed motor-driven CRA insertion provides power run-back capability.
checks.anchor: CRDM high speed motor-driven CRA insertion provides power run-back capability

body.text: Scram starts on two out of four scram signals from the RPS.
body.anchor: A scram is initiated upon receiving two out of four scram signals from the RPS

body.text: The RPS signal de-energizes the scram SOVs, which vent the cylinder and disengage the CRA. The CRA inserts by gravity.
body.anchor: The RPS scram signal results in de-energizing the scram solenoid-operated valves

body.text: Two of the three scram valves are enough to vent the cylinder, so failure of one valve does not prevent scram or cause a spurious scram.
body.anchor: a failure of one scram SOV does not inhibit the safety function to scram

body.text: The scram valves also vent on loss of power to the SOV.
body.anchor: The scram valves vent the scram cylinder on loss of power to the SOV

body.text: The scram valve and cylinder assembly is inside the CRDM housing and is not exposed to primary sodium.
body.anchor: is located within the CRDM housing and is not exposed to the primary sodium environment

body.text: The RPS signal also starts driveline scram follow, where the motor drives the driveline down at maximum insertion speed.
body.anchor: the CRDM motor drives the driveline downward at maximum insertion speed

body.text: Scram follow gives assurance that the CRA is fully inserted and provides insertion position indication.
body.anchor: Driveline scram follow provides assurance that the CRA is fully inserted

checks.q: How many of the three scram valves must actuate to release a CRA?
checks.x: Two of three is sufficient, so a single valve failure does not prevent scram.
checks.anchor: Actuation of two out of the three scram valves is sufficient

checks.q: What inserts the CRA in the SR scram function?
checks.x: The released CRA inserts into the core by gravity. Motor scram follow is NSRST.
checks.anchor: The released CRA inserts into the core by gravity

checks.q: Power is lost to the scram SOVs. What happens?
o: Valves vent and the CRAs release
checks.x: Scram valves vent the scram cylinder on loss of power to the SOV.
checks.anchor: The scram valves vent the scram cylinder on loss of power to the SOV

checks.q: What is the purpose of driveline scram follow?
o: Assure full insertion and provide insertion indication
checks.x: Scram follow provides assurance of full insertion and position indication.
checks.anchor: Driveline scram follow provides assurance that the CRA is fully inserted

body.text: Coupled CRA position goes to the RMC through motor shaft and ball screw revolutions monitoring and a linear position transducer.
body.anchor: through motor shaft and ball screw revolutions monitoring and a linear position transducer

body.text: CRA scram insertion is indicated by full driveline scram follow insertion position.
body.anchor: CRA scram insertion is indicated by full driveline scram follow insertion position

body.text: The CRDM also has scram valve position indication and thermocouples that interface with the NIC.
body.anchor: scram valve position indication and thermocouples which interface with the NIC

checks.q: After a scram, what indicates CRA insertion?
o: Full driveline scram follow insertion position
checks.x: CRA scram insertion is indicated by full driveline scram follow insertion position.
checks.anchor: CRA scram insertion is indicated by full driveline scram follow insertion position

body.text: The CRDM housing is a lower housing flanged to an upper housing, with a top access plate.
body.anchor: The CRDM housing consists of a lower housing flanged to an upper housing

body.text: Metallic seals and bellows keep cover gas and aerosolized sodium from entering the lower housing.
body.anchor: Metallic seals and bellows are provided to isolate reactor cover gas and aerosolized sodium

body.text: The housing runs with an inert gas purge and static overpressure from the SCG, so leakage flows into the cover gas space.
body.anchor: such that seal or bellows leakage flow is directed into the cover gas space

body.text: Purge gas flow monitors in the SCG supply line identify leakage.
body.anchor: Purge gas flow monitors are provided in the SCG gas supply line to identify leakage

body.text: The CRDMs are cooled by the ambient environment of the HAA.
body.anchor: The CRDMs are cooled by the ambient environment of the HAA

summary.text: The 13 drives use a gas-held latch. Venting the cylinder releases the CRA to insert by gravity.
summary.anchor: The released CRA inserts into the core by gravity

summary.text: Two of three fail-safe scram valves are enough. A scram starts on two of four RPS signals.
summary.anchor: A scram is initiated upon receiving two out of four scram signals from the RPS

summary.text: The motor gives fine control, run-back, and NSRST scram follow, which also confirms full insertion.
summary.anchor: Driveline scram follow provides assurance that the CRA is fully inserted

title: Control Rod Drive System
subject: CRD
intro: The CRD moves the control rods and lets them go. The motor gives fine control and fast insertion. The scram itself needs only gas venting and gravity.
